name: jarvis-kanban
description: Jarvis Kanban — convention-based kanban boards for actors, projects, and events

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle

jarvis.kanban.autoProvision.description: Automatically provision bundled Copilot Skill and Instructions files into the workspace on activation.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_createKanbanBoard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new kanban board YAML file for an actor, project, or event. Returns the file path. If ownerName is omitted, resolves the calling actor via jarvis_whoAmI.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_verifyKanbanSchema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validates a kanban board YAML file against the schema and semantic rules. Returns structured errors and warnings.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_openKanbanBoard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens a kanban board in the webview renderer. If ownerName is omitted, resolves the calling actor via jarvis_whoAmI.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_updateKanbanItem
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates fields on an existing kanban board item by ID. Merges changes into the item, validates status values. If ownerName is omitted, resolves the calling actor via jarvis_whoAmI.

itemId.description: The ID of the item to update.

changes.description: Key-value pairs of fields to update. The 'id' field cannot be changed.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_addKanbanItem
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Adds a new item to a kanban board. Auto-assigns id; validates values before writing. Omit ownerName to address your own board.

status.description: Status value. Defaults to first declared status option if omitted.

fields.description: Values for declared fields (key = field name, value = string).

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_deleteKanbanItem
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a kanban board item by ID. The deleted id is never reused. Omit ownerName to address your own board.

itemId.description: The ID of the item to delete.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_listKanbanItems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists kanban board items with optional status and/or labels filter. Returns compact projection (id, name, status, labels). Omit ownerName to address your own board.

status.description: Filter by status value. Must match a declared option.

labels.description: Filter by labels — all must be present on the item.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_updateKanbanFields
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Adds or removes field definitions or options on a kanban board. Refuses to remove fields/options still referenced by items. Omit ownerName to address your own board.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.
